purpose: Test whether ranking industries before stocks removes the frozen Champion's unintended repeated-industry allocation while preserving Industry Diffusion plus Low-MAX economics.

frozen_construction.schedule: exact frozen Champion weekly signal dates
frozen_construction.industry_score: inclusive fraction of exact eligible industry members with causal action-coordinate r20 greater than zero
frozen_construction.industry_selection: ten industries ranked by industry_score descending, then industry
frozen_construction.stock_selection: within each selected industry choose one stock by max_return20 ascending, then symbol
frozen_construction.breadth: exactly ten stocks from ten distinct PIT industries
frozen_construction.holding: 20 completed sessions, then next legal due open
frozen_construction.cohort_weight: unchanged one-quarter NAV; equal stock weights
frozen_construction.corporate_actions: unchanged QD-010 pre-effective exit and cash/share ledger contract

sequential_periods.validation_access: only after every generation requirement passes

single_executable_translation.authorization: only after both screen gates pass
single_executable_translation.rule: Top ten industries by diffusion; one lowest-MAX stock per industry.

prohibited: alternative industry count, member floor, score, stock count, rank, schedule, horizon, cost, or weighting
market filter, exposure overlay, exit change, leverage, or second replay
OOS, independent confirmation, or live claim
